name: RX-50V
summary: Semi-automatic biochemistry analyzer with an 8-filter optical system, Peltier-controlled flow cell and built-in PT/APTT coagulation. Runs end-point, kinetic, fixed-time and multipoint tests with built-in quality control, a thermal printer and memory for 1,000 patient results.

specs.label: Methods
specs.value: Absorbance, end point (standard or factor), kinetic, fixed time, differential, multipoint calibration (up to 10 standards)

specs.label: Coagulation
specs.value: PT and APTT at 405 nm; results in seconds, % or INR/ISI; auto or manual start

specs.label: Sample types
specs.value: Serum, plasma, CSF, urine, whole blood, hemolysate

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: Halogen lamp, 12 V / 20 W or 6 V / 10 W

specs.label: Dry bath incubator
specs.value: 15 positions for 13 mm tubes, 4 positions for 10 mm tubes

specs.label: Timers
specs.value: 3 built-in (T1–T3), presets of 3, 5, 10 and 15 min, editable up to 99 h

specs.label: Cuvettes
specs.value: Removable macro, semi-micro and micro, plastic or glass

specs.label: Aspiration
specs.value: Continuous-flow peristaltic pump, programmable 100 µL – 3.0 mL

specs.label: Result memory
specs.value: 1,000 results with patient ID (128 KB EEPROM)

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: 3 levels per test, Levey-Jennings charts, Westgard rules, last 30 QC results stored

specs.label: Display
specs.value: Graphic LCD, 240 × 128 px, blue LED backlight

specs.label: Keypad
specs.value: Soft-touch keys with 35 direct test keys; optional USB keyboard

specs.label: Built-in printer
specs.value: Thermal graphic, 50 mm/s, 384 dots/line, 57 mm paper

features: Online kinetic graph with OD display, graph editing and result estimation
Stores reagent blank absorbance and up to 10 kinetic graphs
Triplicate calibration for end-point, kinetic and fixed-time tests
Triplicate sampling with mean, SD and CV
Built-in calculators for lipid profile, A/G ratio, serum iron/TIBC and bilirubin
Air purge between samples to reduce carryover
35 direct test keys for fast test selection
Printouts include laboratory and doctor names
Data backup to USB flash drive
